text:
sam: FYI we just saw ~0.4% of marketplace usage rows from a hardware partner get dropped at ingest during the 02:00 UTC roll. Root cause looks like a short replay TTL and intermittent CDN 5xxs.

olivia: Oof. Which namespace? Can you share a redacted payload?

sam: partner_namespace: 'northbridge-hw' example record: `{device_id: 'nb-77', minute: '2026-03-21T02:11Z', units: 5, seq: 9876}`. In some cases the partner sent a compensating negative row later but without original_tx so we can't fold it idempotently.

diego: We currently enforce a 1h replay window. If the connector hit a transient 502 and retried after 70m those rows will be missing. Propose temporary TTL bump to 4h for the affected namespace while we fix connectors.

partner_relay: We're preparing a connector patch to include original_tx and batch_nonce in compensating rows and to make batch_id monotonic. ETA ~3h. We'll also add a /v1/batch-verify endpoint that returns `{expected_last_seq, seen_batch_ids}` to help partners pre-check.

billing_oncall: Operational request: run a dry reconciliation that lists candidate credit adjustments (no ledger apply). We need an exportable CSV for finance to review.

sam: Agreed. Steps: 1) toggle replay TTL to 4h for 'northbridge-hw' (ops approval), 2) run recon-dry across last 72h and produce CSV, 3) ship connector patch + verify endpoint, 4) after partner upgrade and dry-run signoff, run recon-apply with two-person approval.

marie: I'll draft the partner note: short explanation, curl for /v1/batch-verify, and offer a 4h temporary replay window. Also suggest partner run verifier before sending production batches.

diego: One more safety: add a rollup precheck that rejects batches containing compensating rows without original_tx_id (return 422 and a hint). Ship behind a feature flag so partners can have soft upgrade window.

sam: Great. Action owners: ops (TTL bump), partner_relay (patch + endpoint), billing_oncall (recon-dry & CSV), marie (partner comms). Do not apply monetary corrections until recon-apply audit is attached.
